$note: Build sheet for the tabsh Railway template. upsert.py writes the template straight from this file; it is the regeneration master (no source project is kept). Every non-obvious choice carries a $note.

$upstream.whyOwnImage: Upstream ships release binaries only, no container image. The image wraps the checksum-verified v1.5.1 binary (web UI embedded via build.rs) with Caddy. The binary needs glibc 2.39, so the base is node:22-trixie-slim (bookworm's 2.36 fails with GLIBC_2.39 not found).

tabsh.$note: One container: Caddy on PORT in front of tabsh on 127.0.0.1:7681. tabsh's guard (src/web/guard.rs host_is_address) 403s any Host that is not localhost or an IP, with no env override, so Caddy rewrites Host to 127.0.0.1:7681. That makes every request a loopback peer, and tabsh hands its token to loopback browsers at /open, so Caddy basic auth gates everything except /api/* and /ws, which tabsh itself refuses without the token (none is a page in is_page). The app sends that token as Authorization: Bearer, which is why those two paths cannot also sit behind basic auth.

deploy.$healthNote: Caddy serves /healthz without a password by proxying tabsh's public /app/manifest.webmanifest, so it fails when tabsh is down and leaks nothing.

volumeMounts.$note: HOME=/data/home in the image: tabsh state (~/.tabsh), shell history, cloned repos, npm globals and agent logins all survive redeploys. boot.sh removes lost+found and chowns HOME to node once.

TABSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the browser login (user: admin). Generated per deploy; read it from the Variables tab.

PORT.$note: Caddy listens here and the domain targets it. tabsh also reads PORT, so boot.sh passes 7681 to it explicitly.
PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on (the domain targets it)

$agents.$note: agents.sh runs as node before tabsh on every boot: it seeds seed/home into HOME once (marker ~/.tabsh/agents-seeded, cp --update=none so existing files win), then npm installs the latest Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode into the volume (timeout 240, not fatal). Unpinned by request. First boot ~100s, restarts ~25s.
$agents.hooks: Each agent's hooks call /usr/local/bin/tabsh status per tabsh's own src/cli/setup.md contract. Codex uses its lifecycle hooks (UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest, Stop), newer than setup.md's notify advice, and seed/home/.codex/config.toml pre-trusts them by the path+sha256 Codex writes after /hooks Trust all. OpenCode is 1.x (latest is 1.19.4; setup.md's plugin targets an unreleased 2.x), so the plugin uses the 1.x export shape and dedupes the repeated session.status busy events.
$agents.verified: 2026-10-27, fresh stranger deploy on Railway (first boot SUCCESS in 79s, restart 42s), cards driven with test/agent-card.sh: Claude Code (sonnet), Gemini CLI (2.5-flash) and OpenCode (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5) each went backlog -> in_progress -> completed with the agent's own note. Codex reached in_progress through the seeded hook trust with no bypass flag, and a real logged-in Codex turn went in_progress -> needs_input via Stop. Codex marking completed itself is the one step not exercised.
